title: CTC Breakdown Input
summary: Splits a job offer's CTC into what is actually paid monthly, so the headline number isn't mistaken for take-home pay.
description: Splits CTC into fixed pay, variable, ESOPs, joining bonus, gratuity and PF, estimates gratuity and PF in one tap, works out monthly in-hand pay under India's new tax regime with every assumption written down, and flags offers where in-hand is far below the headline.
catches: Variable pay, ESOPs and one-time bonuses counted in the headline
Gratuity and employer PF that never reach the bank account
In-hand pay far below the headline (minInHandRatio)
Parts that add up to more than the CTC
limits: An estimate under India's new tax regime only; old-regime deductions, HRA and other income are not modelled
Assumes basic is 50% of fixed pay, PF capped at the ₹15,000/month wage ceiling and ₹2,500 professional tax unless you change the assumptions
Tax rules are built in as of the verification date and need updating each budget
a11y: Each amount has a <label>; aria-invalid and aria-describedby to its error
Colour swatches are aria-hidden; parts are named in text
Results are announced in a visually hidden aria-live="polite" region
Estimate actions move focus to the field they fill

sources.label: Income Tax Department: Salaried individuals for AY 2026-27 (new regime slabs, 87A)

rules.note: Informational; not tax advice. Checked new-regime slabs (₹4 L nil up to 30% above ₹24 L) and the ₹60,000 87A rebate up to ₹12 L for AY 2026-27. Not checked: that FY 2026-27 is unchanged, surcharge bands, the 4.81% gratuity factor, the PF wage ceiling and professional tax.
